description: Restores the cargo registry and the target directory, and saves them only from a push or a schedule on develop or main. A cache written by a pull request or by a merge queue ref is visible to nothing else, so saving there only spends the repository quota and evicts the caches the default branches seeded.

cache-hit.description: In `save` mode, the `cache-hit` output of the restore step; an exact hit is not saved again.

extra-path.description: Extra path to cache besides the registry and the target directory, such as ~/.cargo/bin.

mode.description: `restore` (default) or `save`. Call `save` as the last step of the job.

prefix.description: Key prefix, unique per workflow or job.

name: Rust cache

cache-hit.description: `true` when the exact key was restored.
